name: PNG image
description: Portable Network Graphics, a lossless image format

name: JPEG image
description: JPEG, raw or in the JFIF or Exif file format

name: GIF image
description: Graphics Interchange Format, version 87a or 89a

name: WebP image
description: Google's image format, in a RIFF container

name: BMP image
description: Bitmap, a format used mostly in the Windows world

name: TIFF image
description: Tagged Image File Format, little or big endian. Many camera raw formats are built on it
extensions: tif, tiff, dng, cr2, nef, arw, pef, srw, nrw, 3fr, erf, dcr, kdc

name: HEIC image
description: High Efficiency Image Container, as iPhones save photos

name: AVIF image
description: AV1 Image File Format

name: JPEG 2000 image
description: JPEG 2000, as a file or a raw codestream
extensions: jp2, j2k, jpf, jpm, jpx, mj2

name: Icon
description: Windows icon

name: Photoshop document
description: Adobe Photoshop's own file format

name: MP3 audio
description: MP3 with an ID3v2 tag

name: MP3 audio
description: MP3 without an ID3 tag, or with an ID3v1 tag (which is at the end of the file)

name: WAV audio
description: Waveform Audio File Format, in a RIFF container

name: AIFF audio
description: Audio Interchange File Format

name: FLAC audio
description: Free Lossless Audio Codec

name: Ogg media
description: Ogg, an open source media container, often holding Vorbis or Opus audio
extensions: ogg, oga, ogv, opus, spx, ogx

name: MIDI
description: Musical Instrument Digital Interface sound file

name: M4A audio
description: MPEG-4 audio

name: MP4 video
description: MPEG-4 video

name: ISO media
description: ISO Base Media file, the container MP4, MOV and HEIC are built on

name: QuickTime video
description: Apple QuickTime movie

name: 3GP video
description: 3GPP multimedia, from older mobile phones

name: AVI video
description: Audio Video Interleave, in a RIFF container

name: RIFF file
description: Resource Interchange File Format, the container WAV, AVI and WebP are built on

name: Matroska or WebM
description: Matroska media, which WebM is built on

name: Flash video
description: Flash Video

name: Windows Media
description: Advanced Systems Format, for Windows Media audio and video

name: PDF document
description: Portable Document Format

name: Rich Text
description: Rich Text Format

name: XML document
description: XML, starting with its declaration
extensions: xml, svg, xsd, xsl, plist, rss, atom, gpx, kml, csproj, config, xaml, xhtml

name: Office document (old)
description: Compound File Binary Format, a container from Microsoft used by Office before 2007, Windows Installer and others
extensions: doc, xls, ppt, msi, msg, vsd, dot, xlt, pot, pps, pub, mpp, db
hex: D0 CF 11 E0 A1 B1 1A E1

name: UTF-8 text
description: UTF-8 byte order mark, at the start of some text files
extensions: txt, csv, json, html, md, xml, srt

name: UTF-16 text (little endian)
description: UTF-16LE byte order mark, at the start of some text files

name: UTF-16 text (big endian)
description: UTF-16BE byte order mark, at the start of some text files

name: UTF-32 text (little endian)
description: UTF-32LE byte order mark

name: UTF-32 text (big endian)
description: UTF-32BE byte order mark

name: Zip archive
description: Zip, and formats built on it, such as EPUB, JAR, Office documents and Android apps
extensions: zip, docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp, epub, jar, apk, ipa, xpi, kmz, docm, xlsm, pptm, dotx, xltx, potx, odg, whl, nupkg, vsix, war, ear, aar, cbz, 3mf, msix, appx, xps, oxps, usdz

name: Gzip archive
description: Gzip compressed file

name: Bzip2 archive
description: Bzip2 compressed file

name: XZ archive
description: XZ compressed file, using LZMA2

name: Zstandard archive
description: Zstandard compressed file

name: 7-Zip archive
description: 7-Zip archive

name: RAR archive
description: RAR archive, version 1.5 to 4 or version 5

name: Cabinet archive
description: Microsoft Cabinet file

name: Windows program
description: DOS MZ executable and its descendants (including NE and PE)
extensions: exe, dll, sys, scr, cpl, ocx, efi, com, drv, mui, ax, pyd, node

name: Linux program
description: Executable and Linkable Format, for Linux and other Unix programs
extensions: elf, so, o, bin, ko, out, appimage

name: Mac program
description: Mach-O executable, 32 or 64-bit

name: Java class or Mac universal program
description: A compiled Java class, or a Mach-O universal (fat) binary, which share a header

name: WebAssembly
description: WebAssembly binary module

name: Script
description: A script that names its interpreter on its first line (a shebang)
extensions: sh, py, pl, bash, zsh, rb, js, php

name: SQLite database
description: SQLite 3 database
extensions: sqlite, sqlite3, db, db3, s3db, sl3, gpkg, mbtiles

name: Packet capture
description: Network packets captured by tcpdump or Wireshark, in the pcap or pcapng format

name: TrueType font
description: TrueType font

name: OpenType font
description: OpenType font with PostScript outlines

name: WOFF font
description: Web Open Font Format, version 1 or 2

name: OpenSSH private key
description: OpenSSH private key file

name: SSH2 public key
description: SSH2 public key file, in the RFC 4716 format

name: OpenSSH public key
description: OpenSSH public key, as in authorized_keys

name: PEM file
description: A certificate or key in the PEM format
extensions: pem, crt, key, cer, csr, pub
